reviews.title: Product Review
reviews.comment: This Samsung 27" Essential S3 curved monitor has been a great upgrade. The picture quality is crisp and clear in Full HD, and the 1800R curve makes it much more comfortable for long work or gaming sessions by reducing eye strain. The 100Hz refresh rate is a noticeable improvement over standard monitors—everything feels smoother, especially when scrolling or gaming. Game Mode is a nice bonus and really helps enhance contrast and visibility while playing. Setup was quick and easy, and the monitor feels well-built for the price. Overall, this is an excellent value with great performance, solid quality, and a sleek design. Highly recommend for work, casual gaming, or everyday use.
reviews.author: Andy's Thoughts

reviews.title: High quality monitor for gaming or home office
reviews.comment: What's not to love about a Samsung curved monitor? This is my first curved monitor and I was a little worried that it might be strange to work with. I use it in my home office and I have honestly loved it from day 1. The picture quality is lovely, it is easy on my eyes, and I get a lot less eye strain since getting this. My son has one that he uses for gaming (I know traditionally these curved monitors were made for gaming) so I can imagine it provides quite an immersive experience. The stand is the perfect height and the set up was easy.
reviews.author: Maaz Raheel

reviews.title: Best monitor I’ve bought in 40 years - Beutiful
reviews.comment: OMG My husband and I love Samsung brands! I’ve had my previous monitor for over ten years ( not Samsung) and it was “ok” but I read about blue light built in protection since I have chronic eye strain from too much screen time for work ) I decided to try this and GAME changer ! The curved ( had flat screen before ) helped both eyes and neck as view is more natural and the reduce eye strain feature is incredible ! I like  a “bright “ view as thought it’d be easier to see- I was wrong - it only took my eyes one day to adjust from bright screen to blue light reduction help and it’s EASIER to read and a gorgeous look!
reviews.author: Fred Paisley

reviews.title: Good value for 120
reviews.comment: Purchased this 27inch monitor when it was 120. Build quality seems good. Stand is very sturdy. Works right out of the box. Im hoping it will last at least a yr

reviews.title: A MUST BUY
reviews.comment: This monitor is a HUGE upgrade from my old one. This one is curved which makes you feel immersed into whatever you’re doing. Also the difference between 24’ and 27’ is extremely noticeable and was much needed. Overall, this is a very good and affordable monitor, and it’s to set up.
